before.requirement: Reach the depth-limit rejection when printing an array at depth 1000.
before.reason: The complete old print_array body has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the rejection when print_array receives an array at depth 1000.
after.reason: The guard returns false at depth 1000, causing the public print calls to fail. The entry constructs no tree; its parser rejects a 1001st nested container, so no fuzz input reaches this guard.

source_evidence.quote:
#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

claims.reason: The rejection is added by g0001; the old harness cannot supply the required tree.

before.requirement: Reach the depth-limit rejection when printing an object at depth 1000.
before.reason: The complete old print_object body has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the rejection when print_object receives an object at depth 1000.
after.reason: The new guard returns false at depth 1000. The entry has no object construction path, and parsing rejects the 1001st nested container.

source_evidence.quote:
#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

claims.reason: The rejection is added by g0002; the old harness cannot supply the required tree.

before.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child within an array.
before.reason: print_array sends children to print_value, which supports Raw. parse_value creates no Raw item, so the harness cannot provide one.

after.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child within an array.
after.reason: The Raw printing route remains available, but the unchanged parser and harness still cannot produce a Raw child.

claims.reason: On both sides, the same parse-only setup prevents a Raw child from reaching the array print path.

before.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw value within an object.
before.reason: print_object sends member values to print_value, which supports Raw, but the parser produces no Raw item.

after.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw value within an object.
after.reason: The Raw member print route remains available, but the unchanged parser and harness still cannot create its input item.

claims.reason: On both sides, the same parse-only setup prevents a Raw value from reaching the object print path.
